title: Add AppUserModel_ID awareness to FancyZones

status.label: Manual build-toolchain remediation required
status.detail: Exact upstream FancyZonesLib and affected native tests fail with missing v143 (MSB8020). The legitimate installed v145 alternative also fails in pinned dependencies on removed stdext::checked_array_iterator and the experimental-coroutine contract (STL1011). No exact-head passing build receipt was recovered. This is an environment blocker, not a new author defect or approval.

next_action: Install a compatible VS2022 Desktop C++ v143/MSVC 14.4x toolchain, then rerun the exact-head library and test builds and focused tests.

blockers.detail: Four actual isolated build attempts exited 1 on clean upstream f0d6c56baab7843e38eff6e8c92dbca5e7b70450. Both v143 attempts report MSB8020. After restoring the exact declared NuGet packages and recursive gitlink-pinned submodules, both installed v145 attempts fail on compiler/STL incompatibility in native dependencies. Actual installed compiler directories and PlatformToolsets implementations show only MSVC 14.51.36231/v145; vswhere reports only VS2026 Enterprise. The author validation narrative and green spelling/Copilot jobs are not exact-head build proof.
blockers.remediation: Install Visual Studio 2022 or Build Tools 2022 with Desktop development with C++, the MSVC v143 x64/x86 toolset (compatible v14.40 / VS17.10 component for this pinned dependency baseline), Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, and native C++ test tooling. Installation requires separate authorization. Check out the pinned upstream head without changing source or dependencies and select the compatible VS2022 developer environment. From src\modules\fancyzones\FancyZonesLib and then src\modules\fancyzones\FancyZonesTests\UnitTests, run the repository tools\build\build.cmd -Platform x64 -Configuration Debug with SolutionDir set to the checkout root. Use the documented local SpectreMitigation=false property only if Spectre libraries are absent. Require both builds to exit 0 before running VS2022 vstest.console.exe on the resulting FancyZones.UnitTests.dll with the AppZoneHistoryTests filter. Preserve exact head/tree, commands, toolset version, and TRX results; recheck existing posted findings without duplication.
